profile.name: PMData · participant p01
profile.history: Public PMData research participant p01. No DNA or methylation is supplied. No connection to the GIAB family.
profile.data_notes: 2020-03-01 to 2020-03-31. Separate participant; DNA absent. CC BY-NC 4.0; derived daily summaries.

metadata.selection: Last 30 dates with all three metrics. Resting HR retained; steps sum available minute records; sleep sums minutesAsleep from distinct logs. Missing observations not imputed.
metadata.timestamp_interpretation: Original calendar dates retained. UTC noon is a display convention; original sensor timezone is unspecified.
metadata.limitations: Independent participant, not a GIAB donor. Historical observations, not current health; device estimates are not clinical measurements.

metadata.source_name: Oxford Nanopore GM24385 public methylation release
metadata.selection: chr20:35433000–35443000, coverage ≥10 reads, at most 500 cytosine sites; beta = methylated/(methylated+unmethylated).
metadata.limitations: Same public cell-line identity as HG002, separate experiments/batches. Not cartilage, blood from the app user or a health score. Site IDs are genomic coordinates, not array probes.
